# MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3 Calibration checks - Hot Forge induction billet heater #3
Revision: Rev B
Plant: P1, line P1-L1
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-IH03

Scope
This maintenance manual section covers calibration checks and baseline functional verification for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03). Tasks include visual coil condition check, sensor output verification, connector and cable continuity inspection, and application of specified lubricant where noted. Refer to MM-P1-L1-IH03 for full equipment history and to SOP-P1-L1-03 and SOP-P1-L1-05 for safety and lockout procedures.

Tools
- Multimeter rated for industrial controls
- Insulation resistance tester
- Hand tools and connector extraction kit per MM-P1-L1-IH03
- Clean lint-free cloths and approved electrical contact cleaner
- Lubricant: CFW-LUB-188

Procedure
1. Secure equipment per SOP-P1-L1-03 and confirm line isolation using SOP-P1-L1-05.
2. Perform visual inspection of the heating coil assembly. Note any deformation, discoloration, or conductive debris and record findings in the maintenance log.
3. Verify sensor outputs at their harness connectors with the multimeter. Compare readings to baseline recorded in MM-P1-L1-IH03.
4. Check insulation resistance on primary and secondary conductors with the insulation resistance tester. Document results in the calibration record.
5. Inspect connectors and cable terminations for corrosion or looseness. Re-seat connectors as required and clean contact surfaces with approved electrical contact cleaner.
6. Apply lubricant CFW-LUB-188 to designated mechanical linkages per details in MM-P1-L1-IH03.
7. Restore power and observe startup behavior. Record any alarms, fault codes, or deviations from baseline performance documented in MM-P1-L1-IH03.

Acceptance criteria
- No visible coil damage or contamination per visual inspection.
- Sensor outputs match baseline entries in MM-P1-L1-IH03 within allowable tolerance stated in that document.
- Insulation resistance measurements meet the minimums recorded in MM-P1-L1-IH03.
- Connectors and terminations show secure contact and no corrosion after cleaning.
- Lubricant CFW-LUB-188 applied where specified.
- Coil inspection interval for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 290 hours.
